dct_description_sm: Detailed map showing woods, various roads, railroads, town and city plans, waterways, various place names, water sources ("Fonte.").
Covers less area and contains less roads, buildings, etc., than "Environs de Nancy, Division de 1895," published 1904, while script and production of map is the same.
May also be publication of Dépôt de la guerre (France).
